basic_profile.bio: I hail from Hyderabad, India, and I've been a tea aficionado for as long as I can remember. My love for tea began during my college days, where late-night study sessions were accompanied by a warm cup. I currently work as a software engineer, balancing my time between coding and exploring new tea flavors. I enjoy reading about technology and am particularly interested in networking solutions, hence my frequent visits to the GoogleWiFi subreddit. When I'm not working or browsing Reddit, you might find me enjoying a leisurely walk in the park or experimenting with new recipes at home. I'm married to my college sweetheart, and we enjoy traveling together, often seeking out local tea shops wherever we go. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having obtained my degree from a reputable university in India. Over the years, I've gained substantial expertise in networking technologies and have a particular interest in smart home setups. My passion for tea is largely self-taught, nurtured by years of tasting and experimenting with different blends.
